title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - VirtualResource
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/VirtualResource. Represents static data in any form and necessary information such as dataset, configuration file, license, keypair, an AI model, or neural network weights. Subclass of Resource per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Resource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VirtualResource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

copyrightOwnedBy.description: Relationship. Copyright owner(s), either as a free-form string or as a resolvable link to a Gaia-X Credential of a participant. Modeled here as links to one or more LegalPerson entities.

license.description: Property. SPDX identifier(s) or URL(s) to the license document.

resourcePolicy.description: Property. Policy/policies expressed using a DSL (e.g., Rego or ODRL) for access control, throttling, usage, retention.
